# Answered question invalidates pause

## The heuristic

**If the pause depends on the customer doing something they have already done, the clock is running whatever the system says.**


_Why:_ The contractual position and the moral position coincide here, and the customer will argue the moral one. A pause is only valid while the ball is genuinely in their court; the moment they reply it is ours, whether or not an automation noticed.
